commit.summary: bind defect proof to failure fingerprint

functionality.rationale: Incorrect attribution can either accept an unrelated failure as defect evidence or reject a valid bugfix lifecycle.

security.rationale: A forged reproduction result can make a security fix appear proven while the reported behavior was never exercised.

performance.rationale: Attributed proof adds one baseline execution of the trusted regression gate during review.

compatibility.rationale: The defect and generated proof objects gain fields while already accepted legacy bugfix records must remain valid.

concurrency.rationale: Proof executions remain synchronous and task review already serializes record mutation.

platform.rationale: Detached worktree environment construction and trusted tool paths must behave consistently across supported hosts.

persistence.rationale: Attributed proof fields become durable immutable review and integration provenance.

adr.rationale: This changes the persisted deterministic proof contract and its compatibility policy.

architecture.rationale: The change remains inside repository governance and does not alter product runtime modules or dependencies.

roadmap.rationale: Defect proof integrity is repository governance rather than a product delivery milestone.
